limitations: side gait is a jog-like stride with 2 flight phases per step: at 140 logical px/s and this leg length a double-support walk cannot be world-locked at 40 ms (would need +-33 texel feet)

side planted-foot residual at 40 ms boundaries is integer rounding of 11.2/phase (see contact_check); between boundaries the host moves continuously while the frame is held, so at 60 fps a planted foot sweeps the listed excursion and snaps back (frame quantization, disclosed, not a pass)
front/back cycles are in place: a planted foot travels with the host by 11.2 source texels (5.6 logical) per 40 ms
legs are sheared static texels (lean, slight stretch) and far limbs are darkened near-limb copies; coarse frozen statics, no repaint; cosmetic refinement deferred until after MVP
no Pixelorama round-trip, no Godot import, no normal-speed movie in this batch (root owns those)
metrics are not motion acceptance; creator review of a normal-speed movie is required
